sourceBoundary: Begins with Tales to Astonish #27 and ends with Ant-Man (2022) #4. Preserves all 437 source-defined whole-issue occurrences across the guide's eight numbered sections plus Latest Additions, placing each of the 389 published exact identities once at its first occurrence. Two source-required MAX runs (Alias #1-28 and the 2003 to 2004 Ant-Man mini #1-4) remain intentionally excluded under the owner-confirmed policy; see excludedSourceRows.
